title: Architectural Irreversibility: Enforcing Privacy, Governance, and Trust in Intelligent Campus Systems
abstract_snippet: Intelligent campus infrastructure is growing increasingly reliant on sensors and analytics both to aid in safety and coordination, and to interpret the information flows better.
